verdict.rationale: Docs confirm number matching (tap corresponding number to approve), location context (share location hourly to verify country), and admin-gated enablement of push notifications, plus phishing-resistant passkey sign-in — covering the core of the story. However, admin-enforced MFA policy configuration (Conditional Access specifics) and location context are only shown from the end-user side, not documented from the admin policy console, and community evidence notes admins lack full control to restrict alternate methods. Missing for 10: first-party admin-console documentation of configuring number matching/location-aware Conditional Access policies, and independent/hands-on confirmation that these anti-phishing controls work reliably in practice.
